method:
Real PostGIS measurements without sockets; deliberately no HTTP/browser claims.

Run --before before modifying grid.py, then --after in the same workspace.
Both phases use the identical disposable cluster and source bundle. PostgreSQL
is restarted for each SQL invocation, so these are not warm shared-buffer runs.
Application-cold and application-warm are measured separately, OS cache uncontrolled.
unavailable_reason: Sandbox denies localhost sockets (EPERM); escalation rejected.

plans.sql:
SELECT p.grid_x::text||'_'||p.grid_y::text id,
            count(*) denominator,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND (n.reversed LIKE :g0_p0 ESCAPE E'\\')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND FALSE))) AS n0,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND (n.reversed LIKE :g1_p0 ESCAPE E'\\')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND FALSE))) AS n1,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND (n.reversed LIKE :g2_p0 ESCAPE E'\\')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND FALSE))) AS n2,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND (n.reversed LIKE :g3_p0 ESCAPE E'\\')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND FALSE))) AS n3,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND (n.reversed LIKE :g4_p0 ESCAPE E'\\')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND FALSE))) AS n4,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND (n.reversed LIKE :g5_p0 ESCAPE E'\\')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND FALSE))) AS n5,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND (n.reversed LIKE :g6_p0 ESCAPE E'\\')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND FALSE))) AS n6,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND (n.reversed LIKE :g7_p0 ESCAPE E'\\')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND FALSE))) AS n7,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND (n.reversed LIKE :g8_p0 ESCAPE E'\\')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND FALSE))) AS n8,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND (n.reversed LIKE :g9_p0 ESCAPE E'\\')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_name n WHERE n.record_id=p.id AND FALSE))) AS n9
            FROM place_record p WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset GROUP BY p.grid_x,p.grid_y ORDER BY p.grid_y,p.grid_x

WITH region AS (
            SELECT ST_UnaryUnion(ST_Collect(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(ST_Transform(geom,3035),150))) g
            FROM admin_area WHERE dataset_id=:dataset AND level='state'
        ), area AS (SELECT g g FROM region),
        cells AS (SELECT c.i,c.j,ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Intersection(c.geom,a.g),3) g
            FROM area a CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_SquareGrid(:size,a.g) c
            WHERE ST_Intersects(c.geom,a.g))
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i::text||'_'||j::text,
            'cx',(i+0.5)*:size,'cy',-(j+0.5)*:size) ORDER BY j,i) cells,
            (SELECT ST_AsSVG(g,0,0) FROM area) outline,
            (SELECT ARRAY[ST_XMin(g)-:size,-ST_YMax(g)-:size,
                ST_XMax(g)-ST_XMin(g)+2*:size,ST_YMax(g)-ST_YMin(g)+2*:size] FROM area) viewbox,
            (SELECT ARRAY[ST_XMin(ST_Transform(g,4326)),ST_YMin(ST_Transform(g,4326)),
                          ST_XMax(ST_Transform(g,4326)),ST_YMax(ST_Transform(g,4326))] FROM area) bounds
        FROM cells WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(g)

SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(p.id,p.grid_x::text||'_'||p.grid_y::text),'{}'::jsonb) records
            FROM place_record p WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset

SELECT DISTINCT 0 group_index,p.id
                    FROM place_name n JOIN place_record p ON p.id=n.record_id
                    WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset AND (n.reversed LIKE :m0_0 ESCAPE E'\\') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 1 group_index,p.id
                    FROM place_name n JOIN place_record p ON p.id=n.record_id
                    WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset AND (n.reversed LIKE :m1_0 ESCAPE E'\\') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 2 group_index,p.id
                    FROM place_name n JOIN place_record p ON p.id=n.record_id
                    WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset AND (n.reversed LIKE :m2_0 ESCAPE E'\\') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 3 group_index,p.id
                    FROM place_name n JOIN place_record p ON p.id=n.record_id
                    WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset AND (n.reversed LIKE :m3_0 ESCAPE E'\\') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 4 group_index,p.id
                    FROM place_name n JOIN place_record p ON p.id=n.record_id
                    WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset AND (n.reversed LIKE :m4_0 ESCAPE E'\\') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 5 group_index,p.id
                    FROM place_name n JOIN place_record p ON p.id=n.record_id
                    WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset AND (n.reversed LIKE :m5_0 ESCAPE E'\\') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 6 group_index,p.id
                    FROM place_name n JOIN place_record p ON p.id=n.record_id
                    WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset AND (n.reversed LIKE :m6_0 ESCAPE E'\\') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 7 group_index,p.id
                    FROM place_name n JOIN place_record p ON p.id=n.record_id
                    WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset AND (n.reversed LIKE :m7_0 ESCAPE E'\\') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 8 group_index,p.id
                    FROM place_name n JOIN place_record p ON p.id=n.record_id
                    WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset AND (n.reversed LIKE :m8_0 ESCAPE E'\\') UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 9 group_index,p.id
                    FROM place_name n JOIN place_record p ON p.id=n.record_id
                    WHERE p.dataset_id=:dataset AND (n.reversed LIKE :m9_0 ESCAPE E'\\')

WITH raw_region AS (
            SELECT ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(ST_Transform(geom,3035),150) g
            FROM admin_area WHERE dataset_id=:dataset AND level='state'
        ), region AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT g g FROM raw_region),
        area AS (SELECT ST_Collect(g) g FROM region),
        cells AS (SELECT c.i,c.j
            FROM area a CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_SquareGrid(:size,ST_Envelope(a.g)) c
            WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM region r WHERE c.geom && r.g
                AND ST_Intersects(c.geom,r.g) AND ST_Relate(c.geom,r.g,'T********')))
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i::text||'_'||j::text,
            'cx',(i+0.5)*:size,'cy',-(j+0.5)*:size) ORDER BY j,i) cells,
            '' outline,
            (SELECT ARRAY[ST_XMin(g)-:size,-ST_YMax(g)-:size,
                ST_XMax(g)-ST_XMin(g)+2*:size,ST_YMax(g)-ST_YMin(g)+2*:size] FROM area) viewbox,
            (SELECT ARRAY[ST_XMin(ST_Transform(g,4326)),ST_YMin(ST_Transform(g,4326)),
                          ST_XMax(ST_Transform(g,4326)),ST_YMax(ST_Transform(g,4326))] FROM area) bounds
        FROM cells

Plans.Join Filter: ((c.geom && r.g) AND st_intersects(c.geom, r.g) AND st_relate(c.geom, r.g, 'T********'::text))
